about_the_game:
You are an apprentice, eager, untested, and seeking a master worthy of your potential. One day, a mysterious flyer flutters into your hands, promising power, wisdom, and mentorship within the legendary Magiculon’s Tower. But to meet the great wizard himself, you must first prove your worth… by climbing it.

Each floor of the tower is a trial of wit and will - an intricate puzzle of platforms, traps, and pitfalls. You’ll need to manipulate the environment to create your own path upward, using the limited spells at your disposal. As you ascend, you’ll learn new forms of magic - Fireball to leap far and clear obstacles, Ice to freeze platforms and create pathways, Telekinesis to move distant objects, and Rewind to undo your mistakes (or trap yourself in them).

But beware: every misstep can send you tumbling back down, undoing minutes, or hours, of careful progress. There are no shortcuts, no mercy, and no safety nets. The climb is punishing, but every small victory feels earned.

Magiculon’s Tower is a hand-drawn, spellbinding foddian puzzle platformer about perseverance, creativity, and mastery, of both magic and yourself. Will you reach the summit and earn Magiculon’s apprenticeship… or fall endlessly in hopes of greater power?
